<pre><code>#!/bin/bash
# @file hcom-seat
# @brief Start one omp seat for a role in a herdr pane through `hcom omp`, with its profile, policy overlay and extensions wired in.
# @description
#   Plan 025 W5b (U7), the minimal form before X. A seat is one omp process that
#   `hcom omp` starts in a herdr pane (`hcom omp --help`: `hcom [N] omp [args...]`,
#   `--tag <name>`, `--dir <path>`, `--terminal <preset>`; hcom gives the seat
#   HCOM_LAUNCHED=1, HCOM_TAG and HCOM_DIR). For `<role>` the launch line is
#   `hcom omp --tag <name> --dir <dir> --terminal herdr --go -- --profile <role>
#   --config ~/.agents/omp/policies/<role>.yml --config ~/.agents/omp/profiles/<role>.yml
#   --append-system-prompt ~/.agents/omp/rules/<role>.md -e <ext>...`; hcom drops the `--` and forwards what follows to omp verbatim
#   (hcom 0.7.30 and 0.7.31, measured 2026-10-23 and 2026-10-24; `extract_launch_flags`,
#   `src/commands/launch.rs:572-581` at v0.7.30). `--go`
#   is hcom's launch gate: inside an AI tool, hcom without it prints `== LAUNCH
#   PREVIEW == / Add --go to proceed.` and starts nothing (`launch.rs:48,388-389`,
#   measured on the real host 2026-10-23), and `extract_launch_flags` consumes it
#   only before the `--` (`launch.rs:650-652`). The profile equals the role. A
#   named profile reads its own `~/.omp/profiles/<role>/agent/config.yml`
#   (pi-utils `src/dirs.ts:312-315`, U10),
#   so the manifest's `modelRoles.default` and `skills.customDirectories` reach the
#   seat only through the second overlay, rendered per role (U14); the first overlay
#   owns the approval mode (U6). Both are required. The seat's standing rules, rendered per role from the manifest's
#   standing_rules (U75), ride `--append-system-prompt`: the overlays disable the native provider (U66), so no profile
#   context file loads, and the explicit flag also wins over any project APPEND_SYSTEM.md. The rules file is required
#   and must be non-empty, since omp reads a missing path as literal text. The extensions default to the
#   pi-claude-bridge, which the role's model route needs, plus the openai-siwc when it
#   is present; `--ext` replaces that list. The roles are orchestrator and worker; every audit is
#   one fresh `~/.local/bin/common/pr-audit.sh <n> --records <store>` run, never a seat (regime-cutover
#   U57, U58; the omp audit route was retired by U119 round 3). The stop gate's directory
#   `~/.agents/omp/hooks` is loaded on every launch, whatever `--ext` says, and the
#   launch line ends with `--hcom-team <HCOM_TEAM>`: hcom passes HCOM_DIR into the
#   pane but not HCOM_TEAM, so the flag, which the gate registers, carries exactly the
#   team this launch was given, an explicit one included (regime-cutover U33c; omp
#   refuses the flag when no loaded extension registers it, so a launch without the
#   gate fails instead of running unguarded). Every directory, a default, `--ext` or
#   the gate's, must resolve to an entry of `claude.levers.extensions` in the manifest
#   the self-check reads (regime-cutover U31), else the launch is refused. The
#   orchestrator sits in the repository
#   this command runs in; every other role gets the worktree `<seats-root>/<name>`,
#   which is created detached from `origin/main` (HEAD in a repository without it)
#   when absent and reused when it is a worktree of this repository (any other
#   directory at that path is refused). HCOM_DIR, HCOM_TEAM and the seats root come
#   from the environment or `--seats-root` when set, else from the checkout through
#   the sourced regime-env helper (regime-cutover U33: `~/.local/state/hcom/<slug>`,
#   `<slug>`, `~/.local/state/omp-seats/<slug>`), and are exported to the seat.
#   The program store's root `REGIME_STORE_ROOT` (`<physical HOME>/.local/state/regime-store/<slug>`, regime-env's
#   fixed derivation, U215c; regime-cutover U219, store move 3 of 5, handoff/07-store-move-design.md) is held once
#   (store_root_hold: clean, each component a 0700 directory of this user or absent, resolved physically once into
#   `store_root_phys`) and, since U219c (verdict U219-985b7c04), four things hold of it: it is made by every role's
#   launch that finds it absent, before its settings file is written (store_root_make, after the judgement, as the
#   credential root is made, because srt's Linux backend skips an absent path); it is printed verbatim into the
#   orchestrator's write roots (row 7, seat_write_roots, never resolved again) and granted for read to both omp roles;
#   it is denied for write to every other row (the worker's, the dsh's and the router's `denyWrite`, tagged `store`);
#   and every rendered write grant of every role is judged against it (store_root_judge: a row that is, contains or
#   lies inside the root refuses the launch by name, the orchestrator's own row excepted by position and byte
#   equality). An hcom store `HCOM_DIR` that is, lies inside or contains it refuses the launch by name before anything
#   is made (store_root_overlap_check, by identity: the hcom store is every seat's write grant, so the records would
#   lie inside it; verdict U215-15c6be1e P1); the dsh and router rows carry no grant of it.
#   The seat's omp runs under OS containment (regime-cutover U85): Anthropic's sandbox-runtime `srt`
#   (sandbox-exec on macOS, bubblewrap on Linux) with per-seat settings, through an `omp` shim at
#   `<seats-root>/.sandbox/<name>/bin/omp` that is put first on PATH, so hcom pins it as the pane's tool;
#   the shim runs a canary under the settings and refuses to start omp unless a write into the sandbox
#   directory and reads of the settings and `~/.ssh` fail inside (seat_sandbox_write below). srt and omp
#   run by their physical argv (pin_exec), and so do hcom (exec'd by it) and herdr (through wrappers in the
#   shim directory); none of their files may be or lie under a write root of any seat.
#   Every input path (HOME, --seats-root, HCOM_DIR, REGIME_SEATS_ROOT, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR) and every path
#   written into the srt settings must be clean: absolute, components of [A-Za-z0-9._@+-] only, no '.' or
#   '..' component and no trailing '/', since srt reads a settings path as a pattern. The settings are
#   written by the shell (no JSON tool) and read back by /usr/bin/plutil on macOS, /usr/bin/jq on Linux.
#   No caller PATH entry runs anything: the first statement sets PATH to the system directories, the complete protected set is built by (device, inode) identity before mise or any other
#   tool runs, and the tools beyond them (git, hcom, herdr, omp, srt, node, bun, claude, jq; bwrap, socat and
#   rg on Linux) are resolved through `mise which` under `env -i` from `/`, else `command -v` on the
#   caller's PATH, checked (absolute, no control character, an executable regular file, no shim, neither
#   it nor a directory above it with the identity of a seat write root) and linked into
#   `~/.local/state/hcom-seat/tools`; PATH is then that directory and the system
#   directories, for hcom-seat, hcom, the shim and srt (whose Linux settings name bwrap, socat and rg).
#   Inside the sandbox omp gets that PATH followed by the caller's absolute entries.
#   Every executable is checked with its interpreter chain, and hcom-seat, the shim and the wrappers run
#   under `#!/bin/bash`. The git state host git reads for this repository's worktrees (config,
#   config.worktree, info, hooks, commondir, gitdir, the worktree's .git file) is denied to every seat,
#   and a launch over such state holding a key host git would act on is refused (git_state_check) before
#   the first git command; every git command hcom-seat runs has hooks, fsmonitor and worktree config off.
#   Every program's seats root is read-denied but the seat's own paths.
#   No seat launches a seat: the orchestrator's sandbox, like the worker's, has no herdr socket and no
#   write to the seats root, and a launch from inside a seat is refused; seats are started from a
#   terminal outside every seat (the operator or the coordinator, as gate G7 was).
#   Every input is checked before anything is created or started: an unknown role, a launch inside a
#   seat, a name or team outside `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$`, a store regime-env refuses, an absent
#   policy or profile overlay or extension directory, a cwd outside a git checkout, a required tool
#   that is missing, a shim or a file that is or lies under a seat write root, or no sandbox-exec
#   (macOS) or bubblewrap, socat and ripgrep (Linux)
#   is exit 2 with the reason. A seat directory that holds `.omp` is refused too, after the worktree exists and
#   before hcom starts (U66: omp applies the cwd's `.omp/config.yml` at start, which no setting turns off).
#   `--dry-run` prints the launch line, and the derived environment and
#   sandbox on stderr, and creates and starts nothing but the private tool links. Otherwise hcom's own
#   exit status is returned (`hcom omp --help`:
#   0 ready, 1 launch failed, 2 still launching or blocked on user attention).
#   The seat login (regime-cutover U318, U314 alternative A; per login group since U498): every seat's bridge child
#   and the dsh role's gateway child run with `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<seats-root>/.state/claude-<group>`, one directory
#   per login group under the seats root, holding one interactive claude.ai login that Claude Code itself stores and
#   refreshes (the Keychain item keyed to that directory on macOS, `.credentials.json` 0600 there otherwise). The
#   group is a function of the role, the one table `login_group_of_role` (worker, orchestrator and audit each their
#   own; the dsh and router roles the `router` group, since the gateway child is the Router's), copied as text into
#   seat-login-preflight: a role's seats share their group's login, and two groups rotate no refresh token together
#   (U318's one directory per seats root let the Router's long-lived children and the sweep seat rotate one token,
#   and the login was invalidated five times, handoff/40). The directory is the role table's `claude_config` row:
#   this lever makes it 0700 when absent, the shim exports it, seat-login-preflight
#   judges `claude auth status` under it, and the settings grant it for write and deny its `settings.json`,
#   `settings.local.json`, `rules`, `hooks`, `plugins`, `skills`, `commands` and `agents` to every seat, so no seat
#   changes what another seat's child, or the operator's login command, would load from it. Every other group's
#   directory and the legacy shared `.state/claude` are denied for read, by name, to every seat (U498c: srt reopens
#   a root's subtree under an allow but for a more specific deny, so the orchestrator's read grant of the seats root
#   reached the worker group's login until then; the rows come from the table's range, `LOGIN_GROUPS`, minus the own
#   group), and every group's directory of that range is made, 0700 and empty, by every launch before its settings
#   file is written (U498d, login_dirs_make: srt 0.0.81's Linux backend mounts nothing for a denyRead entry that is
#   not there, so a deny of another group's directory bound nothing until that group's first launch or login made it;
#   a link, a file or another user's directory at any group's path refuses the launch by name, own_slots_check and
#   login_dirs_make), and the own group's directory is the one login a seat reads or writes. The legacy shared
#   directory `.state/claude` is read, granted, copied, made and removed by no launch (standing order 54). No token file
#   and no CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN: the shim clears the name, and no seat reads the operator's `~/.claude`.
#   The dsh role (regime-cutover U272, after the four audits of the standalone launcher of PR 687): the DeepSeek
#   harness control host is contained the same way, by this lever, as a role whose differences from the worker are
#   rows of the role table (the `case ${role}` after the options, seat_write_roots, the read grants in
#   seat_sandbox_write, the command the shim execs, the launch at the end) and nothing else. Its rows: no pane and no
#   hcom bus (the launch runs the shim `<sandbox>/bin/dsh` in the foreground, waits and returns dsh's status); a
#   per-launch seat name `<name>-<utc stamp>-<pid>`, so the sandbox, its settings file and the state slot are per
#   launch and two launches at once share no file (the Claude Code directory is the shared one, as for every role); the cwd
#   `<seats-root>/.state/<name>/cwd`, a scratch directory this lever makes (no worktree); the write roots DSH_HOME,
#   that slot, the role's own omp profile `~/.omp/profiles/dsh` (the login child `omp auth-gateway stdio` lives there,
#   selected by OMP_PROFILE, and writes its agent.db at start) and `~/.omp/run`, with no git common directory and no
#   hcom store; the read grants the cwd, that slot, DSH_HOME, that profile, `~/.agents/skills` and the pinned tool
#   directory, with no git common directory, no hcom store and no record of the main checkout (U272c); a deny row
#   (U272d: srt reads everything an explicit deny does not name, so a grant the role lacks denies nothing) naming the
#   physical paths of the checkout's git directory and common directory, the `.git` entry of every linked worktree
#   git lists, the hcom store and every existing `~/.local/state/hcom-*` sibling, the records
#   `<checkout>/.orchestration` and every other seat's directory, denied for read and for write; every row of the
#   final allowRead and allowWrite lists judged against every row of the final denyRead and denyWrite lists (U272f:
#   the rendered settings are the refusal's only source; every path physical and by identity; U272g: the own slots and
#   the own profile exempt from their structural denies by a tag that names each one row by its position in its list,
#   never a spelling, so a DSH_HOME at or inside an exempted row's path is judged like any row), a hit refused before anything is made; DSH_HOME in the protected set
#   before any tool is resolved; the command `<DSH_HOME>/bin/dsh`, a physical executable file that runs inside srt
#   only; and the environment reduced by `/usr/bin/env -i` to HOME, USER, LANG, TERM, PATH, DSH_HOME, OMP_PROFILE and
#   CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR before the shim adds its own exports (regime-cutover U312: a caller's CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
#   is no input for any role). No rules file, `--config` overlay, `-e` list or login preflight is read for it. Its
#   profile config row (regime-cutover U310): the rendered overlay `~/.agents/omp/profiles/dsh.yml` (the generator's,
#   like the seat overlays) is placed as the profile's own `~/.omp/profiles/dsh/agent/config.yml`, the file the
#   gateway child `omp auth-gateway stdio` reads for its model providers, every `extensions` entry rewritten to its
#   canonical `claude.levers.extensions` path as the omp roles' `-e` list is; a config already equal is left alone, a
#   different one replaced and the launch says so, and a linked `agent/` or `config.yml` is refused before anything
#   is made (profile_config_check, a reading that creates nothing; a canonical path holding a control character, a
#   leading `-` or a `#` after white space is refused by name before it is rendered, rendered_path_check, U310f).
#   The write is one run of the pinned helper `profile-config-place.py` on one held descriptor of `agent/`
#   (profile_config_place, regime-cutover U310d: the compare, the exclusive create at a random name, the write, the
#   rename and the read-back all through `dir_fd`; this lever checks no path in `agent/` and then acts on it), after
#   the per-launch slots; the helper runs from the lever's own copy, made once this launch in a directory of its own
#   and hashed there against the manifest pin, so the path beside this file is read once (helper_copy_make, U310f);
#   a dry run runs it with `--dry-run` after settings_judge and writes nothing. The per-launch sandbox and
#   state slot are removed when dsh exits, by a refusal after they were made (refuse), and by the trap a hangup,
#   interrupt or termination runs before this process ends by that signal.
#   The router role (regime-cutover U321, U343i): the dsh row with four cells of its own and nothing else. U317b measured
#   (2026-11-07T00:12Z, the prototype at pin 8c32a9dc) that dsh-superagent's Runtime does not start without the
#   `dsh-host-webserver` plugin, so the Router needs a loopback listener, which the dsh row forbids. The cells: the DSH
#   profile `router`, the only one the role accepts (`--profile router` or none; a `--profile`, `--profile=<name>`, `-p`
#   or `-p<name>` among the verbatim dsh arguments is refused by name too, U321b, so dsh never reads a second selector
#   after the fixed one); `allowLocalBinding: true` in the srt
#   settings (srt 0.0.81 has no loopback-only form, so the grant is bind and inbound on every interface; the upstream
#   Management API bounds it: it accepts the hosts `127.0.0.1:<port>` and `localhost:<port>` alone and only with the
#   `x-orchestrator-request` header, upstream docs/006-deployment.md; the port is the profile's, this role grants
#   binding and no port); the Router's state root `<DSH_HOME>/router-state`, where U317b renders `stateDir`, as a
#   write root of its own (seat_write_roots), derived from the one physical DSH_HOME the launch holds (dsh_home_hold:
#   the DSH_HOME grant, the environment line and the state root all read it, U321d) and held exactly once, by
#   state_root_hold, before anything of the launch is made (U321b, U321c: no link, present a directory of this user,
#   its physical path inside the held home; the rendering carries the held value and nothing resolves the path again);
#   absent, it is made 0700 after the home has passed the deny judgement, in a real launch alone (a dry run makes
#   nothing and says what a launch would make, U321d); and the broker directory `<state slot>/broker` (regime-cutover
#   U343i, the mechanism-change row of 2026-11-10T06:20:28Z, form remove; verdicts U343g-8a049561 and U343h-eb648bcd,
#   class record-path), where acp-broker listens and writes its exit records, denied to the Router for write as one
#   tagged denyWrite row inside the state-slot grant and made 0700 by the launch before the settings are written
#   (broker_dir_make; a dry run says what a launch would make), so the Router reads it and connects to its socket and
#   can plant, rename or unlink nothing in it. The Router's credential root `<DSH_HOME>/router-credentials`
#   (regime-cutover U353, M-26 stage B; U353b; U353d): the one directory the role reads beyond the dsh row's grants,
#   allowRead row 7, where the operator places the agent account's gh login (`router-gh` reads the token from its
#   `gh/hosts.yml`); held like the state root by every role (cred_home_hold, cred_root_hold: under the held physical
#   DSH_HOME for the foreground rows and under the caller's DSH_HOME else `~/.dsh` for the omp roles, which hold no
#   DSH_HOME; no link, a directory of this user, inside the home), made 0700 by every role's real launch before its
#   settings file is written (cred_root_make; the foreground rows after the judgement), because srt 0.0.81's Linux
#   backend mounts nothing for a denyRead entry that is not there (U353d), and denied for read and for write by every
#   row but the router's (the role table's `cred_root_grant` cell: `read` for the router row, `deny` for the dsh row;
#   the omp rows in seat_settings_render) and for write by the router row too, so no role writes it and only the
#   Router reads it. The omp profile, OMP_PROFILE and every other row are the dsh role's, so the role's rendered
#   settings differ from the dsh role's in exactly the binding value, that one write root, that one deny row and the
#   credential root's grant.
#   The router row's broker (regime-cutover U344, M-24 part 2; U344c): the row's `broker` cell starts `acp-broker`
#   from a private per-launch copy of the lever set beside this file (`<state>/acp-broker.<name>/`, each file held
#   as helper_path_check holds a helper and its copy hashed against its `claude.levers.sha256.<name>` pin before the
#   broker's first byte runs, broker_copy_make; the copy run under /bin/bash with the held physical DSH_HOME in its
#   environment) after the settings are written and before the shim, reads the broker's own line `acp-broker:
#   listening on <sock>` from a pipe it holds as the readiness sign (never the socket path's existence, which
#   precedes `listen`; broker_start), and renders `network.allowUnixSockets` naming the socket's directory
#   `<seats-root>/.state/<name>/broker`, the fourth cell's, for this role alone (U342 measured: srt opens the sockets
#   under it and nothing else); when dsh exits, and in the trap, the broker is stopped by SIGTERM, its exit status
#   read and the copy directory removed (broker_stop): a status other than a clean end is named and the launch exits
#   2, never silent (standing order 21). Every role's settings text comes from the one writer both levers source,
#   seat-settings-render.sh (sourced from a private copy hashed against its pin, renderer_source, U344c; every root an
#   argument of this lever), so the worker's settings the broker renders and the dsh row's cannot drift
#   (tests/unit/test_acp_broker.py holds them byte for byte).
# @arg $1 string Role: orchestrator, worker, dsh or router.
# @option --name <name> Seat name, passed as the hcom tag (default: the role; `<role>-<n>` for a second seat of a role); the dsh role appends `-<utc stamp>-<pid>`.
# @option --seats-root <dir> Parent of the seat worktrees (default: ~/.local/state/omp-seats/<slug>, regime-env).
# @option --ext <dir> Extension directory in claude.levers.extensions, repeatable; replaces the role's default list (omp roles only).
# @option --profile <name> dsh and router roles only: the DSH profile, passed to dsh as `--profile <name>` (`[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}`); the router role accepts `router` alone and defaults to it.
# @option --home <dir> dsh and router roles only: DSH_HOME (default: the environment's DSH_HOME, else ~/.dsh); an existing directory.
# @option --dry-run Print the launch line and exit 0 without creating a worktree or a slot or starting hcom or dsh.
# @arg -- dsh and router roles only: everything after it is passed to dsh verbatim; for a role whose profile is fixed, a profile selector among them (`--profile`, `--profile=<name>`, `-p`, `-p<name>`) is refused.
# @env HCOM_DIR The program's private hcom store (default: ~/.local/state/hcom/<slug>, regime-env).
# @env HCOM_TEAM The team thread (default: the repository slug, regime-env); passed to the seat as --hcom-team.
# @env DSH_HOME The dsh role's default home, the opt-in of scripts/update-agent-assets.sh#update_deepseek_harness.
# @stdout The launch line with --dry-run, else hcom's output, or dsh's for the dsh role.
# @exitcode 0 Dry run printed, hcom reports the seat ready, or dsh exited 0.
# @exitcode 2 A refusal, before anything is created or started.
# @exitcode * hcom's own status otherwise; dsh's own status for the dsh role.
# @example
#   HCOM_DIR=/path/to/.hcom scripts/orchestrator/hcom-seat worker --name worker-2 --dry-run
#   scripts/orchestrator/hcom-seat dsh --profile thak -- --version
#   scripts/orchestrator/hcom-seat router --home ~/.dsh --dry-run -- --version
set -euo pipefail
# No caller PATH entry runs anything (regime-cutover U85): before the first external command PATH holds the fixed
# system directories only, and the tools hcom-seat needs beyond them are resolved below into a private directory.
caller_path=${PATH:-}
system_path=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
PATH=${system_path}
# A caller's CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN is no input to any child of this launcher (regime-cutover U312, U318; Codex P2 on
# PR 712): the seats' login is the shared Claude Code directory, so the name goes before the first child process (the
# preflight, srt's version read, hcom, herdr, the shim's canary), not only inside the shim.
unset CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
# Git is steered by no inherited environment (regime-cutover U85): every `GIT_*` variable the caller exported
# (GIT_DIR, GIT_COMMON_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, GIT_CONFIG_* and the rest) is removed before the first git command, so host
# git, and the seat, find the repository from the working directory alone. hcom-seat takes no input that way.
inherited=$(compgen -e) || {
    echo 'hcom-seat: refused: cannot list the environment' >&2
    exit 2
}
while IFS= read -r inherited_name; do
    case ${inherited_name} in
    GIT_*) unset "${inherited_name}" ;;
    esac
done <<< "${inherited}"

# @description Refuse to run unless this file's sha256 equals its pin in the manifest beside it (regime-cutover U31):
#   `~/.agents/agent-config.yaml` for the installed copy under ~/.local/bin/common, which a sandboxed session cannot
#   write, else the checkout's home/dot_agents/agent-config.yaml. Every read is checked; a failure exits 2 naming the
#   file. The pin is the `claude.levers.sha256.<name>` line, which `scripts/generate-agent-configs.py` refreshes.
# @set LEVER_MANIFEST The manifest the pin came from.
# @set LEVER_DIR The physical directory of this file, where the sourced regime-env helper sits (U33).
lever_self_check() {
    local src dir self name pin digest home
    # The directory is split from the path in the shell, so no external producer (dirname) can fail unseen.
    src=${BASH_SOURCE[0]}
    case ${src} in
    */*) dir=${src%/*} ;;
    *) dir=. ;;
    esac
    [[ -n ${dir} ]] || dir=/
    dir=$(cd "${dir}" && pwd -P) || {
        echo "${src##*/}: refused: cannot resolve the script directory of ${src}" >&2
        exit 2
    }
    self=${dir}/${BASH_SOURCE[0]##*/}
    # shellcheck disable=SC2034 # read by the levers that source regime-env from this directory
    LEVER_DIR=${dir}
    name=${self##*/}
    home=$(cd "${HOME}" 2> /dev/null && pwd -P) || home=''
    if [[ -n ${home} && ${dir} == "${home}/.local/bin/common" ]]; then # lint-comparisons: allow both sides are pwd -P forms
        LEVER_MANIFEST=${HOME}/.agents/agent-config.yaml
    else
        LEVER_MANIFEST=${dir}/../../home/dot_agents/agent-config.yaml
    fi
    [[ -r ${LEVER_MANIFEST} ]] || {
        echo "${name}: refused: manifest unreadable: ${LEVER_MANIFEST}" >&2
        exit 2
    }

# seat_sandbox_write); a refusal then removes them first (slots_remove, the one cleanup the normal exit and the trap

slots_made=0

#   held to its pin the way this file is held to its own (lever_self_check), with the same readers; an unreadable

# @description Print the UTC stamp `YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS` of a dsh launch's seat name, from `/bin/date` read status first
#   (standing order 21): a failed read, an empty one or one outside the shape refuses (exit 2) and names no slot.
# @stdout The stamp.
utc_stamp() {
    local stamp
    stamp=$(/bin/date -u +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S) || refuse 'cannot read the time (/bin/date failed)'
    [[ ${stamp} =~ ^[0-9]{8}-[0-9]{6}$ ]] || refuse "cannot read the time ('${stamp}')"
    printf '%s\n' "${stamp}"
}
